Name: Limoncello Valley
Author: JDThreepwood
Description:
[font=Arial][font=Tahoma][size=5]When life gives you lemons... turn them into liqueur[/size]

Do you wish you could bring some more niche and refined alcoholic beverages to the valley? Do you want to relax by the fireplace with a nice Italian delicacy? Look no further! Introducing... [font=Tahoma][size=4]Limoncello: the﻿ pride of Sorrento[/size][/font]


All you need to make this drink are the lemons from PPJA - More Trees, and the Infuser from PPJA - Artisan Valley (as well as the ProducerFrameworkMod needed for those). After putting the lemons in the machine, just relax and prepare to enjoy an after dinner treat.


After installing the required mods, just extract this one into your Mods folder, and enjoy! To remove, simply delete the folder or remove it from the Mods location.

PS: this product sells for as high as the other specialized infuser products, and acts as a more profitable 'schnapp' for Spring.


[/font]
[/font]
